title: Wave 19 actual Play resource and visual contracts

checks.expected: The canonical product Play verification still completes before resource-specific inspection
checks.reproduction: Run the canonical product verification in a fresh Play scene, then inspect the actual objects.

checks.expected: Campfire, workbench, rain collector, and rescue signal render adopted sprites without structure fallbacks
checks.reproduction: After the full Play setup, inspect structureViews and rescueSignalRenderer on the active Scene instance.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime structure connection owner selected from the active Scene

checks.expected: The actual Mr. Kim SpriteRenderer uses the adopted atlas and visibly switches idle, move, and water cells
checks.reproduction: Enter a fresh exploration state and apply idle/move/swimming presentation states to the live renderer.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime player presentation owner selected from the active Scene

checks.expected: Every wood, stone, food, and salvage node renders the matching adopted icon and no geometric resource fallback exists
checks.reproduction: Inspect every live/inactive node root created by the exploration scene and its icon renderer.
checks.recommendedFiles: runtime resource node owner selected from the active Scene
